wikipedia.title: Sindhudurg Fort
wikipedia.text: Sindhudurg Fort (Marathi pronunciation: [sin̪d̪ʱud̪uɾɡ]) is a historical sea fort located in Arabian Sea near the Konkan region of Maharashtra in Western India. The fort, commissioned by Chhatrapati Shivaji, was constructed between 1664 and 1667. The fort lies off the shore of Malvan taluka of the Sindhudurg District in the Konkan region of Maharashtra, 450 kilometres (280 mi) south of Mumbai. It is a protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India.

wikipedia.title: Tarkarli
wikipedia.text: Tarkarli is a village in Malvan taluka in Sindhudurg district in the Indian state of Maharashtra. It is a beach destination and remote place in southern Maharashtra. Tarkarli Beach was declared a Queen Beach of the Konkan region.

wikivoyage.title: Malvan
wikivoyage.text:
Malvan is a fishing port town of 19,000 people (2011) in the Konkan region of Maharashtra. Malvan has a very nice sea-shore. But it is mainly known for famous Sindhudurg fort. Maratha king Shri Shivaji Maharaj built this fort on island of Kurte. 


== See ==
Medha - Within Malvan city Kushewada and Gold Ganpati Mandir
Sindhudurga

The impressive Sindhudurg or Ocean Fort, set on an offshore island, was built in 1664 by the great 17th-century warrior, Shivaji to the glory of the Maratha Empire, is just a stone's throw away. Ferry services start from morning 8 and last boat leaves 1700 hours in the evening. fare for them is ₹57 per person which include return cost as of 2009.

Rock garden near to Sindhudurg Fort. It has on the rocks view of sunset.


== Do ==
Tarkarli
Situated 6 km south of Malvan and 546 km away from Mumbai on the coast of Maharashtra is Tarkarli. The major attraction here is the long and narrow stretch of beach, with its pristine water. On a clear day, you can see the sea bed through a depth of 20 ft.
Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation has one resort here.
MTDC quarters provide snorkelling facilities near Sindhudurga.


== Eat ==
Malvan is famous for seafood. You can have good fresh seafood at Hotel Chaitnya near Malvan Bharad run by Mr. and Mrs. Walke. Worth testing Fried Fish. If you want to try some Malvani dish at your home try Mr. Vidyadhar Padawe's masala shop near Malvan Fish Market. You will get authentic home made Sunday masal, Garam Masala, Malvani Masala.
